introHtml: Seventh Avenue Apothecary candles bring a premium, hand-poured look to your custom branding. Their clean-burning soy wax and signature fragrances make them a favorite for corporate gifts, hotel amenities, and retail displays. Choose from classic amber jars or modern tins, and add your logo with foil stamping or custom labels for a sophisticated finish that stands out from standard candle giveaways.
